question: After recoverable web fallback is restored, should Factory Auto prefer API credentials or preserve the existing browser/WorkOS account first when both are available?
rationale: Either ordering can be implemented safely, but the choice determines which account existing users see after upgrade and is not established by current Factory behavior.

options.title: Preserve web account first
options.body: Keep Auto web-first for upgrade compatibility and require explicit API mode when users want API-key account selection.

options.title: Prefer API with safe fallback
options.body: Try API credentials first but always continue to web after recoverable failures and document that Auto may select a different account.

recommendation.title: Preserve web account first
recommendation.body: Keep Auto web-first for upgrade compatibility and require explicit API mode when users want API-key account selection.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Factory provider implementation and Settings integration are primarily attributed to this owner in available main history.
